Instead of telling players what is right or wrong, the game lets them build missions from scratch and experience the real consequences of their decisions.Trade Space directly addresses the challenge by simulating complex engineering trade-offs. details:
What It Does & How It Works:

Trade Space is an interactive, web-based space mission design game built for students and space enthusiasts. The game allows players to build complete space missions from scratch. Players must carefully balance seven core engineering resources—mass, power, thrust, communication, data, science, and time—while selecting rockets, orbits, scientific instruments, and flight routes. Every decision directly impacts the mission's budget, weight, and success probability, simulating real aerospace engineering trade-offs.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

Space mission design often feels abstract and complex in textbooks. Trade Space turns these difficult concepts into a hands-on, highly engaging educational experience. It teaches players problem-solving, resource management, and systems thinking. To enhance learning, the game features a smart "Try Next Time" feedback card that calculates alternative outcomes and helps players learn instantly from their design mistakes.

Tools & Technology:

To ensure zero barriers to entry and maximum accessibility worldwide, Trade Space is developed as a single, lightweight file using standard web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript). It runs smoothly on any modern web browser, mobile phone, or computer without requiring any installation. The game features full bilingual support (English and Turkish), custom illustrations, an animated helper guide named Robi, and cinematic launch sequences.

Creativity & Key Factors:

What makes Trade Space unique is its focus on "learning by doing" through consequences rather than rigid right-or-wrong rules. Our team prioritized accessibility, making sure students anywhere in the world can open it instantly on their phones. By blending simplified educational physics, multiple game modes (Three Difficulty Levels, Free Workshop, Team Mode, and Random Crises), and rich content (18 achievements, 5 mini-games, and custom mission building), we created an immersive educational space simulation tool.
